UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private profile and notification preferences for an authenticated campus student.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

phoneNumber.description: Saved default contact phone number for faster reporting.

photoUrl.description: Profile avatar URL from Google Sign-In.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether real-time campus alerts are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CampusItem.title: CampusItem
CampusItem.description: A lost or found item reported on university grounds with contact phone number and optional photo.

reporterId.description: UID of the student who reported the item.

reporterName.description: Display name of the student who reported the item.

type.description: Whether the item was lost or found.

location.description: Campus building or ground where item was lost or found.

contactPhone.description: Contact phone number shared with campus students to call and coordinate pickup.

photoBase64.description: Optional compressed JPEG Base64 string of the uploaded item photo.

visibility.description: Campus-wide visibility scope for authenticated students.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when reported (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ItemClaim.title: ItemClaim
ItemClaim.description: A pickup coordination or found claim submitted by another student on a CampusItem.

itemReporterId.description: UID of the parent CampusItem reporter (denormalized for query enforcement).

claimantId.description: UID of the student submitting the claim.

claimantPhone.description: Contact phone number of the claimant.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when submitted (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserNotification.title: UserNotification
UserNotification.description: Real-time notification delivered to a student about claims or item status updates.

senderId.description: UID of the student triggering the alert.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients write FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Private student profile and saved contact preferences.

/users/{userId}/notifications/{notificat.description: User-scoped real-time notifications for pickup claims and updates.

/campus_items/{itemId}.description: Campus-wide lost and found reports visible to signed-in students.

/campus_items/{itemId}/claims/{claimId}.description: Pickup coordination claims submitted on a reported item.
